residualRisks: External Batch/DCS endpoint, credentials, delivery acknowledgement and rollback sign-off remain production-cutover prerequisites.
The restored common and graphical formula lists currently have no active business rows suitable for controlled state mutation; their toolbar and validation paths were tested without fabricating data.
